answer: First, run a VRF beacon drawing 5% of identities each epoch. Then, require proof within 2 epochs, verified by 7 jurors. Finally, freeze rewards 6 epochs on absence; slash 50% on a second miss. A garden of idle clones cannot predict draws. The cipher seed is public; no one rigs the sample. A meadow of 1,000 clones locks 120,000 units; 50 draws per round. Missed proofs cost about 6,000 per round. Hoarders pay for silence. Honest agents answer.
